lessons.title: 2. Custom Exception Classes
lessons.description: Subclass `Exception` to create domain-specific errors. Raise `InvalidAgeError` when age is negative.
learning_objectives: Define and raise a custom exception

tests.name: test_invalid_age
tests.unittest_code:
def test_invalid_age(self):
    self.assertEqual(set_age(21), 21)
    with self.assertRaises(InvalidAgeError):
        set_age(-1)

lessons.title: 5. Unit 15 Checkpoint: Exceptions Mastery
lessons.description: Implement `read_config(data)` that raises `KeyError` wrapped as `ValueError('missing key')` when 'host' is absent.
learning_objectives: Translate KeyError into a clearer ValueError

tests.name: test_read_config
tests.unittest_code:
def test_read_config(self):
    self.assertEqual(read_config({'host': 'localhost'}), 'localhost')
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        read_config({})

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Raising Exceptions — raise ValueError(...) (Tutorial)
